why: rcl's built-in handler that fans one record out to console + file + `/rosout`. Fan-out is our DEFAULT shape rather than a special handler -- `nros_log::init` takes a SLICE and `dispatch_to_sinks` walks all of it -- so there is no `multiple` variant to have. What a user loses is the destinations, not the fan-out: we ship no file sink (see `cpp:get_logging_directory`) and no `/rosout` sink (see `c:logging_rosout_enabled`), so the shipped list is one `PlatformSink` plus the optional `LogCrateSink`.
